name: SoloPush

sources.title: SoloPush homepage — 'Product Hunt alternative for indie makers'
Submit Product route (SPA — same chrome as homepage)

requirements: Indie/solo-built product focus: 'solo-built tools that actually ship'
Account required — 'Sign In' sits next to 'Submit Product' in the nav
Daily launch format: products enter 'Today's Launches'; top 3 products earn recognition badges
Real user reviews are part of the model — 'No hype. Real user reviews and fresh launches every day'
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, URL, logo/icon, category
Launch-day timing awareness — launches roll in daily cohorts with a visible countdown
workflow: Create an account / sign in at solopush.com
Fill in the product listing form (fields behind auth — not publicly visible)
Product joins a daily 'Today's Launches' cohort; community votes/reviews determine the top 3 badges
Optional: paid 'Get Featured' / ads for premium placement
watchFor: Submit form is behind authentication — field list not publicly visible
Sponsored 'Premium Products' section exists — don't confuse paid placement with organic launch
Daily cohort mechanic means visibility is time-boxed; badges only go to the top 3
Site is a small SPA; little public documentation of rules
countsAsLive: The product appears in a 'Today's Launches' cohort / product list with its own public page on solopush.com
unknowns: Whether there is a review queue or launches are instant after scheduling
